property.name: Dragon Treasure Transient & Condotel
property.location: 95-B Vergara 2 Alley, Engineers' Hill, Baguio City, Philippines, 2600
property.description: Dragon Treasure Transient & Condotel is a lodging property in Baguio City that offers short-term accommodations and monthly dormitory rentals.

bookingProcess: Guests select a room, choose check-in/check-out dates, enter their name and contact information, and submit a reservation request. The booking is confirmed after approval.

cancellationPolicy.upTo24Hours: Up to 24 hours before check-in: no cancellation fee
cancellationPolicy.lessThan24Hours: Less than 24 hours before check-in: may be subject to a cancellation fee
